(() => {
  const checks = {};
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.id = 'movingWindowName';
  const detached = document.createElement('section');
  document.body.appendChild(target);
  checks.connected = window.movingWindowName === target;
  detached.appendChild(target);
  checks.detachedByAppend = window.movingWindowName === undefined;
  document.body.appendChild(detached);
  checks.attachedSubtree = window.movingWindowName === target;
  detached.removeChild(target);
  checks.removedChild = window.movingWindowName === undefined;
  detached.insertBefore(target, null);
  checks.insertedChild = window.movingWindowName === target;
  const replacement = document.createElement('section');
  const placeholder = document.createElement('i');
  replacement.appendChild(placeholder);
  replacement.replaceChild(target, placeholder);
  checks.detachedByReplace = window.movingWindowName === undefined;
  document.body.appendChild(replacement);
  checks.reattached = window.movingWindowName === target;
  target.getAttributeNode('id').value = 'attributeWindowName';
  checks.attributeRename = window.movingWindowName === undefined && window.attributeWindowName === target;
  const attr = document.createAttribute('id');
  attr.value = 'replacedAttributeName';
  target.setAttributeNode(attr);
  checks.attributeReplacement = window.attributeWindowName === undefined && window.replacedAttributeName === target;
  replacement.remove();
  checks.subtreeRemoved = window.replacedAttributeName === undefined;
  attr.value = 'detachedAttributeName';
  checks.detachedAttribute = window.detachedAttributeName === undefined;
  document.body.appendChild(target);
  checks.detachedAttributeAttached = window.detachedAttributeName === target;
  const shadowHost = document.createElement('div');
  document.body.appendChild(shadowHost);
  const shadow = shadowHost.attachShadow({mode:'open'});
  shadow.appendChild(target);
  checks.shadowExcluded = window.detachedAttributeName === undefined;
  target.id = 'shadowOnlyWindowName';
  checks.shadowRename = window.shadowOnlyWindowName === undefined;
  document.body.appendChild(target);
  checks.shadowToDocument = window.shadowOnlyWindowName === target;
  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
  fragment.appendChild(target);
  checks.fragmentExcluded = window.shadowOnlyWindowName === undefined;
  document.body.appendChild(fragment);
  checks.fragmentAttached = window.shadowOnlyWindowName === target;
  return checks;
})()
